common_issues: All ingredient names missing canonical _raw suffix - universal blocker fix
'lemon' → no direct allowlist match; closest is 'lemon_juice_raw' (which is appropriate given recipe uses freshly squeezed juice)
'sprig' is not in the allowed display_unit list - convert to 'piece' or 'g'
'inch' and 'clove' display units invalid - convert to 'tsp' (ginger) or 'piece' (garlic)

Several incorrect allergen tags: Sambar/Lemon Rice/Puliyogare tagging 'gluten' is wrong (no wheat ingredients); 'sesame' tag only applies if sesame seeds are present - sesame oil itself is generally not allergenic and Indian convention does not treat it as such, but to be safe we keep 'sesame' where sesame oil is used since the protocol example included sesame for sesame ingredients
Sambar missing 'sambar powder' (use coriander_seeds_raw which is present; no canonical sambar_powder in allowlist; current spice mix acceptable)
Bisi Bele Bath: tagged 'dairy' is correct due to ghee; missing 'nut_free' negation - has peanuts, so not nut_free
Curd Rice 'milk' usage and portion appropriate
Cuisine reclassification opportunities: Bisi Bele Bath is Karnataka (south_indian acceptable), Puliyogare similarly, Sambar/Rasam/Curd Rice all south_indian generic acceptable
